base_source: TTM through Q3 FY2026 from EDGAR 10-Q YTD figures: OCF $3,352.6M (FY25 $3,420.9M - 9M FY25 $949.1M + 9M FY26 $880.8M) - capex $150.4M ($137.4M - $93.6M + $106.6M) - SBC $137.4M ($131.0M - $101.1M + $107.5M) = $3,064.8M / 283.0M current diluted shares (Q3 FY2026) = $10.83/share. Corroborated by TTM net income $3,052.9M = $10.79/share; 3-yr median OE/share was $10.17.
moat_justification: Largest U.S. builder since 2002 (~15% share, doubled in 10 yrs) with procurement scale, a 570k-lot position only 22% owned / 78% optioned plus captive Forestar supply, and a balance sheet ($6.0B liquidity, 21.7% debt/capital) that gains share through downturns - against a commodity product with zero switching costs or network effects, no pricing power (incentives ~10% of revenue, gross margin 21.8% -> 20.7%), open-market land competition, and capable rivals (Lennar, Pulte, NVR).
name: D.R. Horton, Inc.
one_liner: America's largest builder, narrow scale moat 5/10, real buyback - but at $135.57 (12.5x TTM OE $10.83) the weighted IRR is only 10.3% with IV@15% $84.33; clears the 15% hurdle only at ~$84 (~$63 with a margin of safety), and even the bull case ($114.50) is below today's price.
